brief.label: 업무 정리
brief.use: Turn a request into a brief: goal, scope, done-when, what was settled, and what was assumed.

plan.label: 전략 수립
plan.use: Write a change plan: scope, order of steps, risks, and checks that prove it worked.

code.label: 코드 작성
code.use: Make the planned change the way the project works: cause first, only what is used, every place a name appears, then cut and confirm.

conventions.label: 작성 기준
conventions.use: The standard code is written and judged to: the project first, then structure, names, comments, deletion, and errors.

check.label: 빠른 점검
check.use: Check your own change with the cheapest command that would fail if it were wrong.

plan-review.label: 계획 리뷰
plan-review.use: Judge a plan against the brief and the planning standard before anyone edits code.

code-review.label: 코드 리뷰
code-review.use: Judge one code change for behavior, screens, tests, breakage, security, and the plan's done-when.

verify.label: 전체 검증
verify.use: Run the project's full test suite and build exactly as the project defines them.

debug.label: 실패 분석
debug.use: Read a failure, rerun it alone, and say whether it is real, flaky, or older than the change.

style.label: 표준 점검
style.use: Judge a code change, or the project's structure, against the standard in the conventions skill.

research.label: 출처 조사
research.use: Find facts in official sources, checked against the source itself and against what the project uses.

image.label: 이미지 처리
image.use: Put an image into words for a reader who cannot see it: the answer first, every piece of text, and what each kind of image shows.

hire.label: 인력 설계
hire.use: Design a new crew member: role, tools, model, and instructions.

kit.label: 도구 관리
kit.use: Keep this project's skills to what the crew's work uses, and give each member only what its own work uses.

report.label: 보고서 양식
report.use: Shape a result that is not code into its sections, and keep what later work needs in the wiki.

browser.label: 브라우저
browser.use: A real browser (Playwright MCP): open and operate web pages, read pages that need scripts, take screenshots.

app.label: 앱 조작
app.use: The crew app itself: read its help, find tasks, open screens, and resume work in this project.
